protocols.title: Retinalamin (5 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference

protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Page reports registered Russian regimen: 5 mg IM once daily for 10 days, repeated every 3–6 months. 5 mg vial with 1 mL water for injection or saline; entire vial is one dose. Not subcutaneous; not FDA-approved, evidence mostly Russian/open-label.

schedule.description: Entire vial IM once daily; repeat after 3–6 months per source.
